name: tmdb_search
description: Find a movie or show on TMDB by name, for a title that isn't in the candidates (one you know of, or found on the web). Answers up to 10 matches, most popular first, each with its tmdb_id, and excluded when it can't be picked (watched, started, rated, dropped or hidden on Trakt, disliked, not interested, marked seen).

query.description: A title, as it's known in English or its original language.

media_type.description: movie, tv, or any to search both.

year.description: The release (or first air) year, to tell remakes apart; 0 for any year.
